cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Let Them Think They Won
cards.instruction: Protect someone’s confidence by hiding how much you softened the challenge, changed the terms, or withheld an advantage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Congratulations, Mum. Bring your winning cake to the front; I'll make room beside the prize for your photograph.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your cake isn't on the judging table. Where is it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: In the kitchen, where I can admire it privately. You may inspect it after we've celebrated yours.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You withdrew so I'd win. I don't want a photograph of a favor.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll include the judging table. You beat those seven cakes, and they weren't doing you favors. Stand beside yours; I'll take the picture wide enough for you to see what it won against.

reason: Use Mum objection to a favor photograph to widen the celebratory evidence to real competitors, with A controlling timing and framing while concealing withdrawal motive.
